props.direction: Switch between horizontal and vertical modes.
props.paused: Stops the content from scrolling on its own.
props.speed: Controls how fast the content moves (pixels per second).
props.reverse: Moves the content towards the start instead of the end.
props.pauseOnHover: Pauses the scrolling while the pointer is over the component.
props.mask: Fades the content out at both edges. Pass a number or CSS length to set the gradient size.
props.draggable: Allows scrubbing the content by dragging it. When not set, it is enabled only for users who disable movement animation (prefer reduced motion).
props.wheel: Allows scrubbing the content with a mouse wheel or trackpad. A horizontal carousel takes sideways swipes and shift+scroll, a vertical one accepts the regular wheel and stops the page from scrolling while the pointer is over it.
props.shiftDistance: Controls how far one arrow click moves the content.
props.showArrows: Displays navigation arrows over the content.
props.prevIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the start.
props.nextIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the end.

slots.separator: Rendered after every item, including across the seam between repeated copies.
slots.prev: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the start.
slots.next: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the end.
